The country known for the Eiffel Tower is France.

Based on your mood of nostalgia and your preference for psychological thrillers and mysteries from the Golden Age of Hollywood, particularly those by masters like Hitchcock and Kubrick, I recommend **"Vertigo" (1958)**.

Directed by Alfred Hitchcock, this film is a quintessential psychological thriller that explores themes of obsession, identity, and memory. Its intricate plot, stunning visuals, and deep character study align perfectly with your interest in classic cinema and suspenseful narratives. It is widely regarded as one of the greatest films ever made and offers the sophisticated mystery and psychological depth you are looking for.
